text: 金十数据7月12日讯，香港特区政府财经事务及库务局今日（12日）表示，2026年亚太经合组织财政部长会议踏入倒数100天，局方的宣传工作正式展开。会议相关的大型宣传挂画已于7月初在湾仔特区政府大楼外墙悬挂，中环行人天桥的电子显示屏也同步展示，为会议揭开序幕。财经事务及库务局接下来会继续与各相关政策局及部门紧密协作，全力办好、办妥会议，迎接各亚太经合组织成员代表莅临香港，共同推进亚太经济合作，向世界展现香港作为国际金融中心的独特优势。
text_en: Jinshi Data July 12: Hong Kong's Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau said today (12th) that the countdown to the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers' Meeting has reached 100 days, and the bureau's promotional work has officially begun. Large promotional banners for the meeting were installed on the exterior wall of the Wan Chai Government Offices in early July, with electronic displays on the Central footbridge also synchronized, marking the start. The bureau will continue to closely cooperate with relevant policy bureaus and departments to fully host the meeting, welcoming APEC member representatives to Hong Kong to advance Asia-Pacific economic cooperation and showcase Hong Kong's unique advantages as an international financial center.
